idea-plugin.name: CodeLanes
idea-plugin.description:
Read code like a human. CodeLanes replaces the vertical, line-by-line editor for PHP, Java and Python with a canvas of real, editable code blocks laid out in lanes: what a class builds on on the left, the class (or a Python module and its classes) in the middle, its methods on the right, connected by colour-coded, labelled lines.

Made for really understanding code, especially code an AI wrote: no AI, no summaries, just the real code with its structure on screen.

  • The canvas is the editor: every block is a real IDE editor (completion, inspections, refactorings, undo). The file on disk stays plain PHP, Java or Python.
  • Follow a Request: pick a route (PHP #[Route] or config/routes YAML/XML, Spring @GetMapping, @RequestMapping, …, FastAPI, Flask and Django routes) and see the whole chain of code it runs, through interfaces into their implementations.
  • Frameworks: Symfony (PHP), Spring (Java), and Django, FastAPI and Flask (Python). Laravel requests can be shown through your AI assistant.
  • Flows from your AI assistant (MCP): through the IDE's built-in MCP Server, Claude Code, Junie, GitHub Copilot or any MCP client can show a request flow on the canvas (Laravel routes, middleware, events, listeners, container bindings). CodeLanes checks every step against the real code: steps the code proves are drawn solid, the AI's other claims as dotted red lines, and references that don't exist are reported back instead of drawn. Flows are saved in .codelanes/flows/ to reopen later.
  • + calls, Add method… and + parents: follow the flow across files.
  • Review marks and notes shared with your team in .codelanes/, and working sets to save and reopen the canvases of a review.
  • Java and Spring in IntelliJ IDEA: injected beans (also through Lombok), overloads, and AI flows that prove Spring's bindings, events and listeners.
  • Python in PyCharm (new in 0.3.0): a module with its classes and functions, base classes and injected types (typed __init__ parameters, dataclass fields), and AI flows that prove overrides, Django signals and event classes.
  • Lanes, Column and Tree layouts; usage highlighting; Cmd+click stays on the canvas.

Works in PhpStorm (PHP), IntelliJ IDEA (Java) and PyCharm (Python, also IntelliJ IDEA with the Python plugin); other JetBrains IDEs aren't supported yet.

Toggle between blocks and text with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B. Source and issues: github.com/agitri/codelanes.
